capabilities: Speaks with your coding agent using local Whisper speech recognition and the OS voice
Runs morning, midday and evening check-ins with adaptive nudges
Moves kanban cards and tracks focus sessions
Files conversation facts into notes and tidies capture notes daily
Shares vault context with other AI apps over MCP
disambiguation: Not a Microsoft product: an independent plugin that drives Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity as a spoken assistant for your vault.
extras: Desktop only; not yet in the community plugin list (install via BRAT or manually). Runs the engine CLI with file-edit permissions and keeps agent state outside the vault; no telemetry, no account of its own.
problem: Obsidian has no voice interface, and AI assistants for notes usually need a separate account, API key or cloud service.
